criteria.description: The learner's stroke pulse matches the source pulse.
criteria.name: Holds the source tempo
criteria.observable_indicator: tempo error % of the learner's fitted stroke pulse vs the source pulse

criteria.description: Each stroke lands where the source stroke lands, after allowing for overall offset and tempo.
criteria.name: Strokes land on the pulse grid
criteria.observable_indicator: median absolute stroke timing deviation (ms) after offset/tempo fit

criteria.description: Bass (bayan) strokes occur on the same strokes as in the source.
criteria.name: Bass used and withheld where the source does
criteria.observable_indicator: balanced accuracy of the per-stroke bass flag on aligned strokes

criteria.description: Every source stroke is played once and nothing is added.
criteria.name: No missing or extra strokes
criteria.observable_indicator: count of missing + extra strokes after alignment

criteria.description: The pulse does not waver from stroke to stroke.
criteria.name: Steady pulse
criteria.observable_indicator: coefficient of variation of pulse-normalised inter-onset intervals

description: Criteria authored from goal model v1 (tabla_audio). Metric bands live in practice/observers.v1.json; scores come only from the deterministic band policy.
